title: 第二十三章 竞拍筹备大会第二十四章 男女之别
content_zh:
东海县城中，原来的刘府，现今的陆府，客厅偏厅中间的隔板被拆，变成了很大一个厅堂。
此时厅堂中，下面坐了数十个商贾，都是长条凳子，一排排坐着。
陆宁则坐在最前面，面对这些商贾。
他一左一右坐着他的两个女朋友，哦，坐着他的两房美妾，像极了后世的新闻发布会。
这座宅院，现今只有几个仆役看守，陆宁琢磨着，这个宅院，就慢慢改造成各种大会场，反正这刘志才的老宅，总觉得住着不吉利，何况，公府衙门正在扩地，后宅会修出很大的宫落，若是看风景，那就是城郊明湖庄园，这老宅空置着，也没什么用处。
“安静了！”四角站着的是，陆家四大恶奴，陆平、陆霸、陆贵、陆青。
改名时陆宁想到了开封府八壮士中的董平、薛霸、李贵、娄青，如此给他们命名，只是姓氏都随主家而已，其余九太保，情况也差不多。
下面的各路商贾，几乎汇聚了东海县各商行最优秀的掌柜。
其中许多掌柜，东主实则就是陆家。
陆宁创造的“掌柜”这个称呼，现今在东海正流行。
原本这些帮东主经营库、行、肆、店的库头、行头、肆头、店头们，从此有了响当当的称呼。
为东主掌管柜面，可不就是掌柜？这称呼，也透着贵气和对他们的尊重，陆家这些掌柜的，都很感激东主给他们的新称呼。
不过，这些掌柜的，可不知道国主第下，为什么将他们这许多人汇聚在此。
不过国主的令喻，谁敢违背？
甚至，海州刺史杨昭杨大人，也来给东海公，嗯，按东海公的说法，叫“站台”。
杨昭坐在众商贾最后面，当然，他的座位极为舒服，有人伺候茶水，吧嗒着小眼睛，好奇的看着这一幕。
“我有个差事，从你们里面选一个得力的，去帮我办。”陆宁说着话，就点了点面前桌上的锦盒，“帮我把这两个东西，带去东都扬州变卖！”
众掌柜都有些无精打采。
新东主，这位国主第下，听说是个极厉害的人物，连州里的一位参军和国主作对，好像没几天就垮了台。
本县另一个大土豪王缪，被抄家充军。

也就是本县最富有的两户人家，其家产，现今都成了国主的私产。
但说起变卖什么东西，刘家和王缪有什么家当，这些掌柜的都清清楚楚，顶天就是什么血玉镯之类的，几十贯钱百贯钱而已，山长水远的要拿去扬州变卖？
何苦呢？就算多卖几贯，还抵不上来回路途的时间和跋涉之苦啊。
虽然圣上好似赏赐了国主第下一些宝贝，但那些珍宝怎么可能拿出去变卖？不想活了么？
这时，陆宁打开锦盒，从里面摸出个物事，托在掌心，众掌柜都惊呼起来，却见陆宁手里的，是一颗流光溢彩的金色丹丸。
“这是第三代韦天师炼就的金阳丹。”
陆宁的话，更令众商贾一片哗然，现在海州白云观中，是第五代韦天师，而历代韦天师，以第三代寿数最长，传说他活了两三百岁，尔后羽化成仙。
当今的一个活神仙扶摇子陈抟仙长，据说便是第三代韦天师的点化。
如果是第三代韦天师炼就的金丹，那，那真是价值不可估量了。
看这仙丹品泽，还真不是凡品。
“所以，我准备在扬州，搞一个竞拍会，将这金阳丹竞拍。”
竞拍？掌柜们，面面相觑，都不明白什么意思。
“国主第下！”有一名商贾举手，是一位儒雅中年人，城中陆家米行的掌柜王进。
发言前举手是陆宁要求的，王进虽然觉得有些别扭，但别说他们只是面前这位国主第下的大伙计，就算真的富有商人，在国主第下面前，那也蝼蚁一般低微不是？
“你说。”陆宁示意。
“国主第下所说，是不是如同佛寺的唱衣，价高者得？”王进小心翼翼问。
陆宁一怔，想不到，这个世界竞拍的先驱，竟然是那些本该六根清静的出家人，想想也是讽刺。
“如唱衣一般售卖货品，小的以前就想过可不可以用在商铺之中。”王进斟酌着说，“不过，一直不知道该如何运用，国主第下拿出珍奇宝物，小的才茅塞顿开，是啊，此法应该用在珍宝上，如此才可，获利多多！”
陆宁赞许的看了他一眼，笑道：“大概意思，差不多吧，就是咱们将要拍卖的宝贝拿出来，召集大商家，让他们出价，价高者得，当然，前期咱们要炒作宣传，让那些大商家，人人都知道咱们有这个宝贝，还可以做些适当的引导……”
“比如，咱们在扬州竞拍，那就花钱雇人传播流言，说东都留守，喜好这颗仙丹！”

众商贾都是脑子一闪，险些被吓得爆血管。
扬州为南唐最繁华之城市，甚至也可说是天下最繁华之城市，又是南唐对外最大的商港，所以设为东都，东都留守，一直都是圣天子最亲近的权臣，上一任东都留守，是司徒公周宗，现今，则是皇太弟亲领。
造谣造到东都留守头上？
content_en:
In Donghai County, the original Liu Mansion, now the Lu Mansion, the partition in the middle of the living room and side hall was removed and turned into a large hall.
At this time, there were dozens of merchants sitting in the hall, sitting in rows on long stools.
Lu Ning sat at the front, facing these merchants.
Sitting on one side were his two girlfriends and, oh, his two beautiful concubines. It was like a press conference in later generations.
There are only a few servants guarding this house now. Lu Ning thought, this house will be slowly transformed into various conference venues. Anyway, Liu Zhicai's old house always feels unlucky to live in. What's more, the government office is expanding its land, and a large palace will be built in the back house. If you look at the scenery, it is Minghu Manor on the outskirts of the city. This old house is vacant and of no use.
"Quiet!" Standing at the four corners were the four evil slaves of the Lu family, Lu Ping, Lu Ba, Lu Gui, and Lu Qing.
When changing the name, Lu Ning thought of Dong Ping, Xue Ba, Li Gui, and Lou Qing among the Eight Heroes of Kaifeng Prefecture. He named them like this, but the surnames all followed the master's family. The situation of the other nine Taibao was similar.
The merchants from all walks of life below have gathered almost all the best shopkeepers from various merchant houses in Donghai County.
Many of these shopkeepers are actually owned by the Lu family.
The title "shopkeeper" coined by Lu Ning is now popular in the East China Sea.
Originally, these warehouse heads, line heads, shop heads, and store heads who helped the proprietors run warehouses, shops, shops, and shops have since gained famous titles.
Isn't it the shopkeeper to be in charge of the counter for the proprietor? This title also shows nobility and respect for them. Shopkeepers like the Lu family are very grateful to the new title given to them by the proprietor.
However, these shopkeepers don't know why the king of the country gathered so many of them here.
But who dares to disobey the king's order?
Even Mr. Yang Zhaoyang, the governor of Haizhou, came to give Duke Donghai, well, according to Duke Donghai, it was called a "platform".
Yang Zhao was sitting at the back of the merchants. Of course, his seat was extremely comfortable. Someone was serving tea, squinting his little eyes and watching this scene curiously.
"I have an errand. I want to choose one of you who can do it for me." As Lu Ning spoke, he clicked on the brocade box on the table in front of him. "Help me take these two things to Yangzhou, the eastern capital, and sell them!"
All the shopkeepers were a little listless.
The new proprietor, the junior ruler, was said to be a very powerful person. A soldier from Lianzhou joined the army and went against the ruler, and it seemed that he fell in a few days.
Another big local tycoon in the county, Wang Miao, had his home confiscated and sent to the army.
That is to say, the property of the two richest families in the county has now become the private property of the king.
But when it comes to selling things, what property does the Liu family and Wang Mu have? These shopkeepers all know very well that the top of the sky is just a blood jade bracelet or something like that. It only costs dozens of dollars and hundreds of dollars. How long does it take to sell it in Yangzhou?
Why bother? Even if I sell a few more coins, it's still not worth the time and pain of traveling back and forth.
Although the Holy One seemed to have rewarded the king with some treasures, how could those treasures be sold off? Don’t want to live anymore?
At this time, Lu Ning opened the brocade box, took out something from it, and held it in the palm of his hand. All the shopkeepers exclaimed, but what they saw in Lu Ning's hand was a gleaming golden pill.
"This is the Jinyang Pill refined by the third generation Wei Tianshi."
Lu Ning's words caused an uproar among the merchants. Now in Haizhou Baiyun Temple, there is the fifth generation of Wei Tianshi. Among all the generations of Wei Tianshi, the third generation has the longest lifespan. It is said that he lived for two to three hundred years and then became an immortal.
Today's living immortal Fuyaozi Chen Tuan is said to be the enlightenment of the third generation Wei Tianshi.
If it was the golden elixir refined by Master Wei Tian of the third generation, then it would be of immeasurable value.
Look at this elixir, it's really not ordinary.
"So, I am planning to hold an auction in Yangzhou to bid for this Jinyang Pill."
Bidding? The shopkeepers looked at each other, not understanding anything.mean.
"Your Majesty!" A merchant raised his hand. He was Wang Jin, an elegant middle-aged man and the shopkeeper of Lujia Rice Shop in the city.
Lu Ning asked to raise his hands before speaking. Although Wang Jin felt a little awkward, but let alone the fact that they were just the big guys of the emperor in front of them, even if they were really rich businessmen, they would be as humble as ants in front of the emperor, wouldn't they?
"Say it." Lu Ning gestured.
"What the Lord of the Kingdom said, is it like singing clothes in a Buddhist temple, whoever pays the highest price gets it?" Wang Jin asked cautiously.
Lu Ning was startled. He didn't expect that the pioneers of bidding in this world were actually monks who were supposed to be quiet. It was ironic to think about it.
"Selling goods like singing clothes, I have thought about whether it can be used in shops." Wang Jin said after thinking, "However, I have never known how to use it. The Lord of the Kingdom took out rare treasures, and I was suddenly enlightened. Yes, this method should be used on treasures. This way, there will be a lot of profit!"
Lu Ning glanced at him approvingly and said with a smile: "The general idea is that we take out the treasure to be auctioned, call the big merchants, and let them bid, and the one with the highest price will get it. Of course, we will hype it up in the early stage so that everyone in the big merchants knows that we have this treasure, and we can also do some appropriate guidance..."
"For example, if we are bidding in Yangzhou, then we will spend money to hire people to spread rumors that Dongdu is staying behind and likes this elixir!"
All the merchants' minds suddenly flashed, and they almost burst their blood vessels from fright.
Yangzhou was the most prosperous city in the Southern Tang Dynasty, and could even be said to be the most prosperous city in the world. It was also the largest commercial port in the Southern Tang Dynasty, so it was set up as the Eastern Capital.
Are you spreading rumors to Dongdu Liubei?
